numbering: Sequential integer folders without leading zeros

articles.title: Medicare for All: How Would Hospital Billing Actually Work?
articles.description: How would Medicare for All pay hospitals? Explore simplified national billing, hospital global budgets, patient care, staffing, and financial accountability.

articles.title: Can America Afford Medicare for All—or Can We Afford to Keep the System We Have?
articles.description: An evidence-based look at U.S. healthcare spending, insurance costs, administrative waste, and the potential trade-offs of Medicare for All. Savings depend on the specific plan and assumptions.

articles.title: Obamacare vs. Medicare for All: The Difference Between Having Insurance and Affording Healthcare
articles.description: Obamacare expanded access to insurance, but premiums, deductibles and copays can still make care unaffordable. Compare what patients pay under ACA plans with a proposed Medicare for All system.

articles.title: A Festering Wound: The History of Medicare for All and Congress’s Failure to Act
articles.description: A century of national health insurance debates, landmark reforms, and stalled Medicare for All proposals—and the human cost of leaving America’s healthcare problems unresolved.

articles.title: Socialism Is Not a Weapon: Why America Must Debate Policies, Not Labels
articles.description: Political labels should not replace serious debate. Explore how Americans share responsibility through Social Security, Medicare, public schools, and other services—and what that means for Medicare for All.
